title: Chain build QA distinguishes persisted restart recovery from terminal QA failure while preserving the action error and private diagnostics
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed and TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL test server, run run.cmd. The existing fileDb helper isolates all writes to its own scratch database or schema.
S2: Confirm the four tests named in run.tests execute successfully. The full file executes twenty tests, with zero failures or skips; no name filter is used.
expect: The recorded dev restart shape (kit and brand finished, plan running) with persisted LOST_ON_RESTART produces qa.reason=LOST_ON_RESTART while action.error remains QA_NEEDS_REVIEW.
A terminal failed write produces qa.reason=QA_NEEDS_REVIEW; arbitrary interruption markers cannot become a public reason.
A passed final write clears qa.reason even with historical LOST_ON_RESTART metadata.
Raw brief-error and private timing sentinels do not enter stored/public build QA. The owned detail projection exposes the bounded reason.
A different signed-in account receives404 from the actual detail endpoint and no restart reason; an anonymous request receives401.

tests: chain QA reason distinguishes restart before writing without exposing raw diagnostics
chain QA reason distinguishes terminal site QA failure without exposing raw diagnostics
chain QA reason distinguishes untrusted interruption metadata without exposing raw diagnostics
chain QA reason distinguishes successful write with historical interruption metadata without exposing raw diagnostics
